Properties.Name: Cloud Print Failure Notification
Properties.Description:
Launched by the Rock Cloud Print proxy's Lava webhook when a check-in label printer fails or prints slowly. Notifies every active member of the Worker Group on every event, and members of the Volunteer Group only while a service they are scheduled for is running. Each person gets one channel: a push-capable device wins, otherwise their own communication preference. ~DEV STATE: all three send actions are wired and LIVE, but _you must populate_ the worker and volunteer groups.~

*This Workflow Requires the Workflow Stimpack plugin*

Properties.Name: Notify Person
Properties.Description: Runs once per recipient, activated by the For Each action in Start. The loop seeds the Recipient attribute; the first step decides the channel and the three send steps are each gated on it. All three send steps are DEACTIVATED deliberately - nothing can be delivered until someone turns them on.

Properties.Name: Recipient
Properties.Description: The one person this pass of the loop is about. Seeded by the For Each action in Start, which passes the primary alias guid from the recipient list. Activity-scoped on purpose: a workflow-level attribute would be overwritten by every pass of the loop.

Properties.Name: Channel
Properties.Description: push, sms or email - decided by the first step of this activity. Each of the three send steps is gated on this value, so exactly one of them applies to any given person.

Properties.Name: Finish
Properties.Description: Runs once, after the second For Each has finished looping, and completes the workflow. Must stay BELOW Notify Person in this list - StimPack processes active activities top down, and a finished activity placed above its loop activity can run out of order.

Properties.Description: A title for the Workflow Entry block

Properties.Name: Printer
Properties.Description: The printer address the proxy was trying to reach, e.g. 192.168.x.x. Sent by the proxy. For a test event this is the literal word test.

Properties.Name: Event
Properties.Description: failed, slow, or test. A test event is sent by the proxy's test button and must be worded as a test rather than an outage.

Properties.Name: Reason
Properties.Description: The exact failure string the proxy returned, e.g. No route to host. Used unaltered in the message - it is the most specific thing anyone has. Empty for slow and test events.

Properties.Name: Label Count
Properties.Description: How many labels were in the print job that failed.

Properties.Name: Elapsed Ms
Properties.Description: How long the print attempt took, in milliseconds. Drives the seconds figure in the slow wording.

Properties.Name: Occurred At
Properties.Description: When the proxy saw the failure, as an ISO 8601 UTC string, e.g. 2026-09-13T22:03:45Z. Held as text so nothing reformats it on the way in.

Properties.Name: Proxy Name
Properties.Description: Which cloud print proxy reported this, e.g. Kids Check-in Proxy. Matters once more than one proxy is running.

Properties.Name: Consecutive Failures
Properties.Description: How many times THIS printer has failed since it last printed successfully. Deliberately not in the message - it lengthens every one, and Printers Failing carries the more actionable signal. Kept for whoever wants to escalate on it later.

Properties.Name: Printers Failing
Properties.Description: How many distinct printers are failing right now, across all of them. One printer failing five times is a printer problem; five printers failing once each is a network problem. The message names this only when it is more than one.

Properties.Name: Raw Body
Properties.Description: The whole JSON payload as the proxy sent it. A fallback for reading a field the workflow does not map yet, and for diagnosing a parameter that did not land.

Properties.Name: Worker Group (always notified)
Properties.Description: Every active member of this group is notified on every qualifying event. No schedule check of any kind, whatever the day or hour. This is the guarantee that somebody is told when nobody is scheduled. DELIBERATELY EMPTY ON IMPORT - set it before the workflow can notify anyone.

Properties.Name: Volunteer Group (only while scheduled)
Properties.Description: Members of this group are notified only while a service they are scheduled for is running. Scheduled and not declined, within the window. May legitimately match nobody, which is not an error. DELIBERATELY EMPTY ON IMPORT.

Properties.Name: Schedules
Properties.Description: Which schedules count as a live service for the volunteer group. A volunteer scheduled on a schedule not listed here is not notified.

Properties.Name: Offset Minutes
Properties.Description: How many minutes before a service starts the volunteers for it become notifiable. The window runs from (start minus this) to (start plus the schedule's duration). Rock's own IsScheduleActive is false during pre-service check-in.  This allows for a specific offset not based on the schedules offset.

Properties.Name: Printer Name (resolved)
Properties.Description: Working value. The friendly name looked up from Device by IP address, e.g. Kids Printer 6. Falls back to the raw address when no device matches.

Properties.Name: Message Text
Properties.Description: Working value. One wording, sized for SMS, sent unchanged on SMS, push and email - so nobody gets a worse version because of the channel they prefer. Kept under 160 characters in the common case.

Properties.Name: Worker List
Properties.Description: Working value. Comma-separated primary alias guids for every active member of the worker group. Built unconditionally - no schedule check, no filtering. The first For Each splits this.

Properties.Name: Volunteer List
Properties.Description: Working value. Comma-separated primary alias guids for volunteer group members scheduled right now, with anyone already in the Worker List removed so nobody is told twice. The second For Each splits this.
